==About me==

''I'm an avid fan of the WoT series as well as many other SF and Fantasy books and authors. I am hoping to make a significant contribution to the wiki by improving the detail on character, group and place references. I'm not a very literary writer so I may pass on contributing chapter summaries.''

A while back I decided the wiki should have more complete chapter summaries, especially since so many have none at all. So I'm in the middle of a major project to provide or revise all of the chapter summaries. At more or less one chapter a day this is about a two year project. I started about 11/4/2014 and I'm most of the way through book 4 as of 4/28/2015.

Still working my way through doing chapter summaries as of 10/11/2016. I'm almost half way through book 12. I was hoping to finish the summaries by year end, but it may take part way into 2017. Then I may or may not start over again and work on filling in gaps in references, character pages, items etc.
